newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MGX shares rise after acquisition news.
newsitem.headline: MGX shares rise after acquisition news.

text.p: Shares in South African information technology company MGX Holdings Ltd rose on Monday after the firm announced it had made two acquisitions which could prop up its targeted year-end earnings, dealers said.
By about 0809 GMT MGX shares were up 25 cents at 19.25 rand with 17,100 shares worth more than 329,000 rand changing hands.
"I think the share is moving up on the back of the announcement today that they've bought some businesses. The market sees this (move) as positive news," one Johannesburg Stock Exchange dealer said.
MGX said earlier it had bought 32.4 percent of ExSol Solution Systems (Pty) Ltd and the business of The Paper Bank Co (Pty) Ltd for 22 million rand.
The firm said the acquisitions, effective retrospectively from March 1, will be settled by a combination of cash and shares.
On a fully diluted basis, the two new companies were expected to contribute to MGX's targeted earnings growth of 40 percent for the year to June 30, 1998, the firm added.
